move.note: Out of combat a marker moves freely (no action), up to this many squares at a time, round walls.

kinds.name: Link: power
kinds.hint: the grid between plants and cities

light.note: Decision 74: in the dark a marker sees only lit squares (an on light covers squares within its radius that it can see) and the squares within darkSight of itself. Bright environment: lights don't matter, except where Darkness zones are laid.

darkness.note: Decision 76: TN modifiers the sheet suggests in the dark (the player confirms). Attack: a target seen only as a heat signature -2 (no called shots), one in the dark you cannot see -4. Stealth: +2 in an unlit square, -4 when lit or carrying a lit torch. Perception: -2 in the dark, cancelled by night vision or thermal.

hazards.name: Electric
hazards.hint: Sparks and live metal. Cut its power, or don't touch it.

hazards.name: Gas
hazards.hint: A leak: every breath hurts, and a flame turns it into fire.

hazards.name: Poison
hazards.hint: Toxic fumes or a chemical spill.

hazards.name: Steam
hazards.hint: Scalding steam from a burst line; hard to see through.

hazards.name: Fire
hazards.hint: Burning: anything that burns nearby catches.

hazards.name: Heat
hazards.hint: Hot surfaces, a furnace mouth, a vent.

hazards.name: Cold
hazards.hint: A cryo leak, a freezer room.

hazards.name: High water
hazards.hint: Waist- to chest-deep: you wade or swim — every square costs 2. No damage by itself.

hazards.name: Submerged
hazards.hint: Under the surface: whoever goes in holds their breath at once (CON rounds), then CON rolls, then drowning (1d6 a round). Their sheet counts; leaving gives them air.

hazards.name: The Hum
hazards.hint: Something in the signals. Nobody else hears it. Whoever steps in or starts a turn there gets +1 Strain — a Mental Strength roll halves it (to nothing). Sent by itself, once per zone; hidden from players unless you show it.

zones.note: Decision 83: GM-only event zones on a map, rectangles of whole squares with a label and a note. Reminders only: no rule reads them and players never get them. Triggers are numbered T1, T2… per map. Decision 258: Hazard zones (H1, H2…) — a nature (above: icon, suggested dice, the skill to shut it off), on / off, shown to players or hidden, and an optional control piece; players see only the ones on and shown. Damage is never automatic: the GM's Activity line offers the hit. Decision 273: water — High water and Submerged are difficult ground (each square costs 2, rules/props.js → difficultSquares); Submerged starts a breath hold on the sheet by itself and ends it when they leave. Decision 267: the Hum hurts the mind instead — its Strain is sent by itself (a card the player steadies with Mental Strength), once per zone and character; it starts hidden.

marks.note: Decision 82: marks on the table map, purely visual (no rules, no sound, never saved). Per author at most `stamps` stamps and `lines` freehand lines (a new one replaces the oldest), one pinned; unpinned marks fade after fadeSeconds. Player colours avoid the map's own meanings (red enemies, purple NPCs, cyan / blue / green / yellow prop tints, amber selection); the GM draws in amber.

sensor.note: Sensors (decision 69): placed lasers and sensor props keep on (starting state) and tripped_<sense> / disconnected_<sense> flags. Off and the flags are GM-only. Decision 269: reporting sensors notice players — cameras an arc out to their range (in sight, not dark), motion a line, audio a circle; lasers that are on trip when crossed — a line for the GM, never a consequence (rules/sensors.js). reach: min / max a piece can be set to.

floors.note: Decision 184: floors side by side; stepping through a linked staircase or lift costs this many squares of movement.

site.note: Decision 268: the site alert — one meter per live map (the old per-network Trace, merged). Pings and drones add to it by themselves (rules/ping.js → pingGain), the GM moves it however the story says, it never drops by itself. Levels Calm 0 · Twitchy 3 · Alert 5 · Lockdown 7 (rules/ping.js → TRACE_LEVELS). tn: the TN change on that map for the listed skills and the listed classes' Class TN rolls, shown as its own row in the check window. Players are told only a level that has a tn.
